lines.text: [quiet, focused] He told me not to let him get on the train. So I didn't sleep.
[quick, tense] Six-thirty. Platform four. He was already there.
lines.show: 6:30. Platform four. He was already there.

lines.text: [surprised, smiling] Mira? What are you doing here?
[nervous, a little embarrassed] I didn't have a plan. So I spilled my coffee... all over him.
[laughing, a little annoyed] Okay. That's twice now. Are you doing this on purpose?
[soft] The doors closed. The train left without him. I didn't let go of his hand.
[low] An hour later, every phone on the street buzzed at once.
[shaken, quiet] The six-forty train... never made it to the next station.
lines.show: The 6:40 train… never made it to the next station.

lines.text: [quiet, staring at her] You knew. Didn't you?
[hesitant] I couldn't tell him. Not yet.
[uneasy] That night, at eleven eleven... it wasn't my phone that lit up.
lines.show: That night, at 11:11… it wasn't my phone that lit up.

lines.text: [barely a whisper, confused] Mira... why is your voice on my phone?
